headline: Chantry Flats Luxury Reserve
articleBody:
2.8-acre estate featuring primary 68' lagoon pool, guest casita spa suite, and regenerative pollinator meadows. Tesla Powerwall system achieves complete energy independence. Historic oak allee preserved.

Outcome: 23-week delivery. Carbon neutral certification earned. Robb Report luxury homes showcase. Property appraisal shows 36% value increase.
